candidates.statement: Gateway /v1/checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout ~2s), and order's own call to payment also times out (~2s), so the failure originates in the order->payment path rather than the gateway itself.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side telemetry; cannot confirm whether payment is slow or unreachable. Order->payment timeout inferred from traces.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s (~2s) align with gateway->order transport ReadTimeouts; traces show order->payment also ReadTimeout while inventory/redis succeed. Bounded to downstream latency in the order/payment path; payment-side evidence is missing to pin the exact hop.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and logs to confirm the order->payment ReadTimeout origin
Order service server-side traces/logs showing where its 2s budget is spent
Timeout configuration values for gateway->order and order->payment calls
